evals.prompt: /grill-with-docs I want to add a 'pause subscription' feature to our billing service so customers can pause for up to 3 months instead of cancelling.
evals.expected_output: Starts a one-question-at-a-time interview with a recommended answer per question, looking up facts in the repo and capturing resolved terms in CONTEXT.md as it goes.
expectations: Asks exactly one question at a time rather than a list of questions
Provides its own recommended answer alongside each question
Plans to look up facts in the codebase (e.g. existing Subscription states, CONTEXT.md) instead of asking the user for them
Plans to update CONTEXT.md inline when a term like 'Pause' is resolved, and offer an ADR only for hard-to-reverse, surprising trade-offs
Does not start implementing until the user confirms shared understanding

evals.prompt: /grill-with-docs Plan: we're going to split our monolith's 'accounts' module into 'identity' (login, SSO) and 'organizations' (teams, seats, billing contact). Grill me on it.
evals.expected_output: Grills the decision tree one question at a time, challenges the overloaded 'account' term, and treats the split as a candidate ADR.
expectations: Challenges the overloaded term 'account' and proposes precise canonical terms (e.g. User vs Organization vs Customer)
Asks one question at a time, each with a recommended answer, walking dependent decisions in order
Considers whether CONTEXT-MAP.md / multiple contexts are warranted given the split
Identifies the module split as a candidate ADR because it is hard to reverse, surprising and a real trade-off

evals.prompt: /grill-with-docs I'm thinking of replacing our cron-based nightly inventory sync with an event-driven approach using the existing Kafka cluster.
evals.expected_output: Runs a relentless grilling session one question at a time with recommendations, leaving a paper trail of glossary terms and ADRs.
expectations: Asks a single focused first question with a recommended answer rather than dumping a questionnaire
Mentions it will check the existing code/config (e.g. the cron job, Kafka topics, CONTEXT.md, docs/adr) for facts rather than asking
Plans to record the cron-to-event-driven decision as an ADR in docs/adr/ if it's agreed, given it is hard to reverse
Plans to create CONTEXT.md / docs/adr lazily only when there is something to write
